title: When memory holds only three cards
hook: The input cannot fit in memory all at once.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Generate sorted runs under a memory limit and merge them through bounded buffers.

misconception: Sorting a file requires loading the whole file into memory.
objective: Generate sorted runs under a memory limit and merge them through bounded buffers.

claims.text: The input exceeds memory, so each resident chunk becomes a sorted disk run. Later sequential merges combine those runs; the memory bound changes the number of runs rather than the final order.
